fr:frontmatter.fr:title: Topoi: The Categorial Analysis of Logic

fr:mainmatter.fr:p: "Bibliographical Note: This Dover edition, first published in 2006, is a slightly corrected unabridged republication of the revised (second) edition of the work originally published in 1984 by Elsevier Science Publishers B.V., Amsterdam, The Netherlands, as Volume 98 in the North-Holland Series, "Studies in Logic and the Foundations of Mathematics." A new Preface and updated Bibliography have been specially prepared for this reprint."
